paper.title_en: Viscosity heats, diffusion drains: Open-system thermodynamics in unimodular cosmology
paper.abstract_en: In GR with bulk viscosity and in unimodular gravity with energy diffusion, the matter sector is non-adiabatic, and their balance, entropy, and temperature equations match if $Π\leftrightarrow \dot{Q}/3H$. Disagreement over whether unimodular cosmology is adiabatic comes from assigning entropy to matter only or to the total effective fluid. The key is the temperature $T_D$ of the sector absorbing the diffused energy: comoving entropy production is $\dot{Q}(1/T_D-1/T_m)$, yielding earlier limits for $T_D \rightarrow \infty$ and $T_D \rightarrow T_m$. For finite $T_D$, diffusion acts like heat exchange with an external reservoir: unlike viscosity, which only heats a closed fluid, diffusion into a colder bath can cool an open one, breaking the viscosity-diffusion correspondence for observables and stability. Cosmographically, $Π$ is fixed by the deceleration $q$, while diffusion is fixed by the jerk $j$; thus $Λ$CDM is the adiabatic limit of unimodular cosmology but remains dissipative when modeled via viscosity. The diffusive analogue of $|Π|/ρ$ is the shift $c_s^2-ω$ in effective sound speed, set by perturbative stability rather than acceleration. If dark matter is a gas with conserved rest mass, consistent diffusion removes only thermal energy, forbids phantom behavior, and bounds the growth of the cosmological term by the finite thermal reservoir; producing a logotropic dark fluid with conserved particle number would require relativistic dark matter at $z\simeq12$. With the Hayward-Kodama apparent-horizon temperature, the generalized second law in unimodular gravity follows from the local one, whereas for bulk viscosity it must be imposed separately.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在 unimodular 引力与体粘滞两种框架下系统比较开放系统的热力学行为，给出熵产生、温度方程与稳定性条件，并讨论 Hayward-Kodama 视界温度下的广义第二定律，与黑洞/视界热力学主题相关，理论深度较高，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 粘滞生热、扩散耗散：unimodular 宇宙学中的开放系统热力学
decision.abstract_zh: 在含体粘滞的广义相对论中，以及在含能量扩散的 unimodular 引力中，物质扇区都是非绝热的；当 $\Pi\leftrightarrow \dot{Q}/3H$ 时，两者的平衡方程、熵方程和温度方程相互匹配。关于 unimodular 宇宙学是否绝热的争论，源于是将熵仅归属于物质，还是归属于总的有效流体。关键在于吸收扩散能量的那个扇区的温度 $T_D$：随动熵产生为 $\dot{Q}(1/T_D-1/T_m)$，由此可得到 $T_D \rightarrow \infty$ 与 $T_D \rightarrow T_m$ 两种更早的极限。对于有限的 $T_D$，扩散的作用类似于与外部热库的热交换：不同于只加热封闭流体的粘滞，扩散进入较冷热浴可以冷却一个开放系统，从而在可观测量和稳定性上破坏粘滞-扩散对应关系。在宇宙学层面，$\Pi$ 由减速度 $q$ 固定，而扩散由 jerk $j$ 固定；因此 $\Lambda$CDM 是 unimodular 宇宙学的绝热极限，但若用粘滞来建模，它仍保持耗散性。$|\Pi|/\rho$ 的扩散类比是有效声速的偏移 $c_s^2-\omega$，它由微扰稳定性而非加速度决定。若暗物质是静质量守恒的气体，则一致的扩散只移除热能，禁止 phantom 行为，并以有限的热库限制宇宙学项的增长率；要产生粒子数守恒的 logotropic 暗流体，需要 $z\simeq12$ 处的相对论性暗物质。采用 Hayward-Kodama 表观视界温度时，unimodular 引力中的广义第二定律可由局部第二定律推出，而对于体粘滞则必须单独施加。
